name: Smog
description: Visible gas pollution from anything that burns or crushes.

pages.title: Smog
pages.text:
**Smog** is pollution you can see: grey carbon, yellow sulfur and dust, as blocks of gas. It rises and gathers in a cloud over your base.\
\
A thick cloud brings Weakness, Poison, Blindness and worse, and sulfur rain kills crops. Exhaust systems with filters clean it. An Aerometer reads it.
